answer: Trust is sold per proof at 155 POA, and the farm's 508 proofs lock up 78740 POA it never sees again if it cheats. Two separate readers reaching the same answer is the whole of the check. One garden is a pass, one sonnet is a fare, one spiral is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price. Let every applicant face the same trial with Gilder wet-plaster frieze mark brushed onto the baptistery dome, and let the answer read as each wet-plaster frieze is a plaster weight weighed beside the maker's mark.
